name: mockymock-vscode
description: Write, run, debug and cover COBOL unit tests from VS Code -- no mainframe needed.

commands.title: New Test Suite for This Program

program.description: Absolute path to the COBOL program under test (.cbl/.cob/.cobol).

cut.description: Absolute path to the .cut test suite containing the TESTCASE to debug.

case.description: Name of the single TESTCASE to debug, exactly as written in the .cut file. mockymock debug runs exactly one case per session.

executablePath.description: Override the mockymock executable for this session only. Defaults to the mockymock.executablePath setting, then the bundled CLI, then 'mockymock' on PATH.

copybookPaths.description: Folders passed as --copybook-path for resolving COPY / EXEC SQL INCLUDE members. Defaults to the mockymock.copybookPaths setting when omitted.

configurationSnippets.label: mockymock: debug a TESTCASE
configurationSnippets.description: Debug one TESTCASE from a .cut suite with mockymock.

mockymock.executablePath.description: Path to the mockymock executable. Leave empty to use the CLI binary bundled in this extension (if present), otherwise resolve 'mockymock' from PATH.

mockymock.copybookPaths.description: Folder paths passed as --copybook-path on every mockymock run, for resolving COPY / EXEC SQL INCLUDE members. Relative paths resolve against the .cut file's workspace folder. Resource-scoped so each folder in a multi-root workspace can set its own via that folder's .vscode/settings.json. If a zapp.yml or zapp.yaml exists at the workspace root (the same file IBM Z Open Editor's DBB tooling uses), its cobol-language local library locations are also merged in automatically, after this setting's own entries (this setting wins on a duplicate path).

mockymock.lintOnSave.description: Run 'mockymock lint' (static checks only, no Docker) on open/save of a .cut file and show the problems as diagnostics.

mockymock.maxParallelRuns.description: How many .cut files may run concurrently in one test run. Each run compiles and executes inside the shared mockymock-cobc container; raise this only if your setup tolerates concurrent compiles.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No mockymock test suites yet. A test suite is a .cut file that sits next to your COBOL program.
[Create a Test Suite](command:mockymock.newTestSuite)
New to mockymock? The [Getting Started guide](command:mockymock.openWalkthrough) walks you through setup, your first suite, and debugging.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with mockymock
walkthroughs.description: Write, run and debug COBOL unit tests on your own machine -- no mainframe needed.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
mockymock needs two things: its CLI (already bundled with this extension) and Docker Desktop, which runs the COBOL compiler in a container. One click checks both and fixes what it can.
[Check Setup](command:mockymock.checkEnvironment)

steps.title: Create your first test suite
steps.description:
Open a COBOL program (.cbl, .cob or .cobol), then create a .cut test suite next to it. mockymock reads the program and scaffolds one test case per paragraph, with every CALL, file, SQL, CICS and IMS boundary already mocked.
[Create a Test Suite](command:mockymock.newTestSuite)

steps.title: Run your tests
steps.description:
Every .cut file shows up in the Test Explorer, and every TESTCASE gets a play button in the editor gutter. Failures land on the failing line with an expected/actual diff.
[Open Test Explorer](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)

steps.title: Debug a test case
steps.description: Set a breakpoint in your .cbl, then right-click a test case and pick **Debug (Interactive)** to step through your original COBOL with live variables. Prefer a read-only view? **Debug (Execution Trace)** prints the executed path and every mock that fired.

steps.title: Coverage, mutation testing and more
steps.description:
**Run with Coverage** paints executed lines on your .cbl. **Mutation Test** tells you which bugs your tests would miss. Right-click any COBOL file for static analyzers, a Program Flow diagram, and a mainframe-ready export.
[Browse the examples](https://github.com/Landparty/mocky-mock-vscode/tree/main/examples)
